figure.purpose: Ledger values and serif figures; lead figure runs 32px.

column-head.purpose: Small-caps table column heads and ledger labels.

body.purpose: Default UI text; 14px for secondary lines and cells.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, over a rgba(27,29,31,0.36) backdrop.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus halo on inputs and search.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover/press colour, border and shadow changes.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Dialog rise (6px) and toast slide (8px); switch knob.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Skeleton row and chart loading sweep.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Everyday action on paper with a hairline border.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-3-6.7L21 8"/><path d="M21 3v5h-5"/></svg>Check now</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-2,#c7bea9); border-radius:2px; background:var(--paper,#f7f5ef); color:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); font:500 14px/1 'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--paper-hover,#eeeadf); border-color:var(--ink-3,#64676a); } .ds-btn:active { background:var(--land,#ece5d3); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sea-5,#1f5568); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid-ink action per view, with its keyboard hint.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New monitor<kbd class="ds-kbd">N</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#1b1d1f); border-radius:2px; background:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); color:var(--paper,#f7f5ef); font:500 14px/1 'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#000; border-color:#000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--ink-2,#45484b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sea-5,#1f5568); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-kbd { font:500 11px/1 'Public Sans',sans-serif; padding:3px 5px; border:1px solid rgba(251,250,246,0.35); border-radius:2px; color:rgba(251,250,246,0.8); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--hazard,#b8124f); border-radius:2px; background:var(--hazard,#b8124f); color:#fff; font:500 14px/1 'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:var(--hazard-ink,#8e0c3c); border-color:var(--hazard-ink,#8e0c3c); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sea-5,#1f5568); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field with label above; sea focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-2,#45484b); } .ds-input { height:38px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-2,#c7bea9); border-radius:2px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); font:15px 'Public Sans',sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-3,#64676a); } .ds-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:var(--sea-5,#1f5568); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(61,124,147,0.18); }

components.name: Filter Tabs
components.description: Text tabs with a 2px ink underline on the selected one.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; } .ds-tabs button { height:34px; padding:0 10px; border:0; background:none; cursor:pointer; font:500 14px 'Public Sans',sans-serif; color:var(--ink-3,#64676a); box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 transparent; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); font-weight:600; box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--ink,#1b1d1f); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sea-5,#1f5568); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Incident Pills
components.description: Resolved and Ongoing markers in incident tables.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; min-width:40px; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:2px; font:600 12px 'Public Sans',sans-serif; text-align:center; } .ds-pill-up { background:var(--sea-1,#e4eff2); color:var(--sea-5,#1f5568); } .ds-pill-down { background:var(--hazard-tint,#f8e6ec); color:var(--hazard-ink,#8e0c3c); }

components.name: Status Marks
components.description: Shape-coded status: up circle, down pulsing diamond, pending ring, paused square.
components.html: Up Down Pending Paused
components.css: .ds-marks { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:500 14px 'Public Sans',sans-serif; color:var(--ink-2,#45484b); } .ds-mark { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; } .ds-up { border-radius:50%; background:var(--sea-4,#3d7c93); } .ds-down { background:var(--hazard,#b8124f); transform:rotate(45deg) scale(0.86); animation:ds-beacon 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-pending { border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--amber,#e0a43a); } .ds-paused { border:2px solid var(--ink-3,#64676a); border-radius:1px; } @keyframes ds-beacon { 50% { opacity:0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-down { animation:none; } }

components.name: Check Tick Strip
components.description: Whole-cell check history graded by response depth; hatched empty slots.
components.css: .ds-ticks { display:flex; gap:2px; height:22px; } .ds-ticks i { width:3px; height:100%; border-radius:1px; } .ds-ticks .d0 { background:var(--sea-5,#1f5568); } .ds-ticks .d1 { background:var(--sea-4,#3d7c93); } .ds-ticks .d2 { background:var(--sea-3,#7fb0c2); } .ds-ticks .d3 { background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sea-4,#3d7c93) 0 3px, transparent 3px 5px); } .ds-ticks .t-down { background:var(--hazard,#b8124f); } .ds-ticks .t-none { background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rule,#e0d9c9) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px); }

components.name: Ledger
components.description: Ruled line of serif figures under small-caps labels; never tiles.
components.css: .ds-ledger { display:flex; margin:0; } .ds-ledger > div { padding:0 18px; border-left:1px solid var(--rule-2,#c7bea9); } .ds-ledger > div:first-child { border-left:0; padding-left:0; } .ds-ledger dt { font:600 15.5px/1.2 'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif; font-variant-caps:all-small-caps; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:var(--ink-2,#45484b); } .ds-ledger dd { margin:2px 0 0; font:600 20px/1.1 'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums; color:var(--ink,#1b1d1f); } .ds-ledger dd.lead { font-size:32px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-ledger .alert dd { color:var(--hazard-ink,#8e0c3c); }

narrative.overview:
Pulse is set like a printed nautical almanac. Every monitored service is a row in a ruled table with fixed columns, tabular figures and a strip of whole-cell history marks. The ground is warm chart paper, ink is near-black, panels and the app bar take a buff land tint, and health is read in graded chart-water blues. Outages are the one loud thing: chart magenta, a diamond-shaped mark that pulses, and a washed row. Healthy screens are quiet; a down screen is unmissable.

Density is that of a reference table, not a dashboard of cards. Structure comes from 1px hairlines rather than boxes: a full-ink rule opens every table and list, a lighter rule separates rows, and a mid rule closes. Headings, large figures and column heads are in Source Serif 4; everything you operate is in Public Sans with tabular lining numerals. The signature device is the tide chart in the monitor detail: response time drawn as one deep-blue curve over tinted depth bands (100 / 300 / 1000 ms, each band a fixed share of the height), with its peak labelled in serif italic like a high-water figure.

The user rejected the earlier aurora world (gradient blobs, glassmorphism, purple-cyan gradients) and it may not return.
keyCharacteristics: Warm chart-paper ground, iron ink, buff land panels; light scheme only.
Ruled tables, not cards: 1px hairlines, ink rule on top.
Status carried by mark shape plus colour: blue circle, magenta diamond, amber ring, grey square.
History as fixed whole cells, graded by response-time depth.
Serif for headings, figures and small-caps column heads; sans for UI, tabular numerals everywhere.
Flat paper. Shadow only on overlays and the focus halo.

rules.name: The Magenta Means Act Rule
rules.body: Hazard magenta appears only where something is down, failing or destructive. A healthy screen contains none of it.

rules.name: The Depth Grading Rule
rules.body: Healthy history is graded, never flat green: checks under 100 ms are sea-4, under 300 ms sea-3, under 1 s sea-2, 1 s or slower amber. Public day cells follow the same ladder by uptime: 99.9%+ sea-4, 99-99.9% sea-3, 95-99% amber, under 95% hazard; missing data is a hatched empty cell.

rules.name: The Ink Is for Doing Rule
rules.body: Solid ink fill marks the primary action and the selected state. The only other ink surfaces are transient overlays (toast, day tooltip).

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular and lining, and every numeric column is right-aligned, so polling changes values without moving anything.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is for reading (headings, figures, column heads); sans is for operating. Public service names are the one sans heading (600, 16px), because they read as row labels.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing resting on the page casts a shadow. A surface earns a shadow only by floating over the page (dialog, toast).

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every table and list opens with a 1px ink rule, separates rows with 1px rule, and closes with 1px rule-2. No boxed cards.

rules.name: The Whole Cell Rule
rules.body: History is a fixed count of discrete cells (40 checks at 3px with 2px gaps; 30 days in a 30-column grid with 3px gaps). Empty slots are hatched placeholders; the count never changes and cells never merge into a line.

dos: Do open every table and list with a 1px ink rule and separate rows with 1px rule hairlines.
Do pair every status colour with its mark shape: sea circle, magenta diamond, amber ring, grey square.
Do grade healthy history by depth (sea-4, sea-3, sea-2, amber) instead of a single green.
Do set every number in tabular lining figures and right-align numeric columns.
Do keep corners at 2px (1px on cells, 3px on dialogs).
Do use Source Serif 4 for headings, figures and small-caps column heads, and Public Sans for controls and body.
Do keep motion short and eased (150-180ms, `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)`), and drop all of it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't bring back aurora gradient blobs, glassmorphism or purple-cyan gradients.
Don't use hazard magenta for anything that is not down, failing or destructive.
Don't put resting content in shadowed or rounded cards; shadows belong to dialogs and toasts only.
Don't fill a surface with solid ink unless it is the primary action, a selected state, or a transient overlay.
Don't merge or smooth history marks into sparklines or area charts; the cell count is fixed.
Don't use field white as a page or panel surface; it belongs inside inputs only.
Don't let polling move layout: columns and row heights stay fixed while values change.
